title: Mixed Event — Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show! — Episode5 Vivid On The Ski Slopes

meta.Event: Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show!
meta.Episode: Episode5 — Vivid On The Ski Slopes
meta.Event Outline: After successfully wrapping up their ambassadorial performances, Wonderlands×Showtime is preparing to put on a New Year's show at the new and improved Wonder Stage. Unfortunately, Lion Dance Robot seems to be feeling a bit under the weather...

rows.Line: Morning
Ski Resort
se_event_liondance_2023_004

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Go, Akito, go!
Straight ahead!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You can still win, An!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just a bit more...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's no way I'm gonna lose!
se_event_liondance_2023_004
se_event_liondance_2023_003

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Over the finish line!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Grr... So close...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I won this round!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<So close!
It was like a ten-centimeter gap!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Heh heh heh!
Including the matches from yesterday, we're at three wins, three losses and three draws for the snowboarding competition!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Why are you bragging, Rin?!
An's the one doing all the work!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Now now. It's understandable to want to defend the person you're rooting for♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <So, KAITO, I win our little bet♪>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <No... My ice cream for today...>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I thought I had a winning record in the bag, but we're back to being even.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But this is far from over.
We need to declare a winner before we leave!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're on.
I hope you're not underestimating my stamina.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Right back at... Wait, huh?
Where'd Kohane and Toya go?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
They were practicing just over there...
Oh, I think I see them.
se_event_liondance_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
U-Uh oh... I can't stop...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Pizza, Aoyagi! Turn your skis in!
se_event_liondance_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Pizza? L-Like this...? Ah, I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Toya's having some trouble since it's his first time skiing.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <However, he looks happy getting to experience something new.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I thought he was fine after spending yesterday teaching him, but I guess it just isn't that easy. Maybe we should go help them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane! Toya!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hi, An!
How'd your contest go?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everything's back to being even after me winning just now! But I'm definitely gonna win it all in the end!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
I wish I could do what you and Akito can do, Shiraishi. I still have quite a bit of work ahead of me it seems.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You just need some time to get the hang of it, Toya! I mean, I've been coming here since I was really little.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, same here.
Still, I wasn't expecting to go on a New Year's skiing trip together...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We have Ken and his friends to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I couldn't believe it when my dad and his friend asked us to do a show at their lodge... But thanks to them we get to be here! Lucky us!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That's true.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's so nice to spend New Year's together like this.
“What a wonderfully snowy village!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? That voice...
But there's no reason for him to be...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No... Based on my experience, he appears when you least expect it...

rows.Speaker: Snake Deity
rows.Line:
“Brr... So cold!
I will need to go into brumation to survive this.”

rows.Speaker: Lion-Dog
rows.Line: “But it's so pretty! There's snow as far as the eye can see! I really wanna run around in it!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “Yes, I can empathize. You do not come across such beauty every day. I, Tsukasanosuke Tenma, feel very moved by this view!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I knew it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, does this mean Wonderlands×Showtime is going to do a show...?! Here of all places...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We wouldn't want them to see us, so we should probably hide.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, I agree.>

rows.Speaker: Shapeshifting Fox
rows.Line: “Well, it is nice to see a troupe like this for a change. It may actually be worth this shapeshifting fox's time to join in on the festivities.”

rows.Speaker: Shapeshifting Fox
rows.Line:
“Let us see how it goes...
Hello there, traveling performer. Do you have a moment?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“Hm? Yes, what is it?
Ah, could it be that you wish to perform with us?!”

rows.Speaker: Shapeshifting Fox
rows.Line:
“Yes, more or less.
I happen to be well versed in these sorts of performances, so I believe my skills will be of some service to you.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“Really?!
Then, we would love to have you!”

rows.Speaker: Shapeshifting Fox
rows.Line: “However, I do not wish to take part in any poorly thought-out performances. I must see more before I deem your show worthy...”

rows.Speaker: Shapeshifting Fox
rows.Line:
“So, do not mind me.
Please perform as you all normally do.”

rows.Speaker: Snake Deity
rows.Line: “Perform? For you...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “For someone who wishes to join us on our journey, you ask quite a lot of us...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“However, I also find that admirable!
So, in that case...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “You are more than welcome to join us!!!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “H-Hm? You seem dissatisfied...!”

rows.Speaker: Snake Deity
rows.Line:
“Of course he is...
I strongly doubt that he is some sort of simpleton.”

rows.Speaker: Lion-Dog
rows.Line: “So, what do we do?”

rows.Speaker: Lion-Dog
rows.Line:
“Oh, I know!
Let's have everyone here help us!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“Ah, excellent idea!
These villagers can... Hm?!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?
Is Tsukasa looking towards us...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, don't make eye contact...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have a feeling that he has already seen us...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“You there, villagers!
Let us hear what you think!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh, really...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “I would very much like to have that fox join us, but he will not at this rate.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “Do you know of any better ways to invite someone to join your troupe?”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
H-how to invite someone...?
U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's actually a very difficult question.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Invite them... To join your troupe...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What if you made him excited somehow? You could try convincing him that great things will happen if he joins you!

rows.Speaker: Snake Deity
rows.Line:
“Excited, huh...?
Yes, that is an interesting proposition!”

rows.Speaker: Lion-Dog
rows.Line: “Oh, then! Can you tell us what makes you excited the most?”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Me?
Well... Whenever I hear a song like this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “Hm?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“Ah, yes!
You have an astounding voice!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Don't I?
But if you really want Mr. Fox here to become your friend, you might wanna try something like... This!

rows.Speaker: Skiers
rows.Line:
What was that?
Is someone singing? They're really good.

rows.Speaker: Skiers
rows.Line: Is there a singer performing somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Little Boy
rows.Line:
Whoa! That was so cool...!
I wish I could sing like you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hm?
Do you wanna sing with me?

rows.Speaker: Little Boy
rows.Line:
Me?
But... I'm not really good at singing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That doesn't matter one bit!
What's important is whether or not you want to sing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And it's the best feeling in the world!
So, let's sing! Together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'd like to join in!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “Ah, I would not have thought of this...! Singing with this sort of power will surely convince our fox here to join us!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“Everyone! Please help us!
Let us all sing together!”

rows.Speaker: Skiers
rows.Line:
Haha! That sounds fun!
Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Skiers
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everyone on the slopes! I hope you're all ready! And try to keep up, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Skiers
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
I have no idea what's going on, but something amazing's just begun!

rows.Speaker: Skiers
rows.Line: This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez, they're gonna melt all the snow if they're not careful...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (They got the crowd this excited in so little time...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Their energy! Their ability to invigorate an audience! This is incredible!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I would definitely love to have this sort of explosiveness!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nicely done, Shiraishi!
You had the entire ski resort eating out of your hand!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha! Thank you very much!
I had a lot of fun being a part of your show!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, you were so cool just now...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, you sure do tend to leap before looking.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, what's that supposed to mean?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Tsukasa!
We're all set to move to our next location!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wonderful!
Parting is such sweet sorrow, but we must get going!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you all for participating!
Until next time! Farewell!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Break a leg, Tsukasa!
se_event_liondance_2023_005

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That was so much fun. We got to be in a surprise New Year's show!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it was a nice way to start the new year.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That might depend on who you ask, but you guys did put on a good performance...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Didn't we though?
I've been doing street performances since I was little, so I'm always good to go, wherever and whenever!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. That's good to hear.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You all sounded like you were having fun, so I decided to watch. That was a great performance, An, Kohane.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm looking forward to hearing more fun and exciting songs from you in the future.>

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks!
